messages.author: 46b63db5e5ff7d37
messages.subject: HTML5: graphs don't display well
parts:
Dear lists,
I'm very sorry for the troubles...

Here is the test file test.Rmd:
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# set global chunk options
opts_chunk$set(fig.path = 'figure/slides-', cache.path = 'cache/
slides-', cache = TRUE)
options(width = 55)
```
# A test

```{r test, message=FALSE, fig.cap='Function as
arguments',fig.width=7, fig.height=3}
mfun <- function(fun, x = seq(-3, 3, by = .2), ...){
y = fun(x)
plot(x, y, ...)
}
mfun(sin)
```
First, I run `knit("test.Rmd") and get the test.md file and the
test.html file, no problem here.
But when I use `pandoc -S -s -i --mathjax -t dzslides test.md -o
test1.html` to generate the HTML5 slides,
the test1.html doesn't display the graph well, just a black region!

I tried many times but can't find the problem :(

Thanks in advance!

Regards,
Weicheng

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] HTML5: graphs don't display well
parts:
Hi, 

Since the test.md looks fine it sounds like this issue is related to pandoc rather than knitr, so you might have better luck posting on the pandoc-discuss list instead.  Your graph displays correctly for me.  Have you made sure you are running the most recent version of pandoc, and the figure is appearing in the path as specified in the test.md file?

-Carl
